summary: Kaixin Holdings filed a Form 6-K disclosing a supplemental share issuance tied to its August 26, 2026 acquisition of Hongkong Taohaoche Limited from seller Hsiao-Ching Chiu. The original consideration was 10,000,000 newly issued Class A ordinary shares, escrowed and subject to performance targets. Due to a stock price decline from over $5.00 to under $1.50 per share, the board approved an additional 10,000,000 Class A shares on September 3, 2026, also escrowed under six-year performance targets. The target became an indirect wholly owned subsidiary. No financial advisors or premium details were disclosed. Watch for stock-price volatility and escrow-release milestones under the purchase agreement.
